releaseTitle: ATalk v3.10.2 — Khroma AI Themes, Procedural Wallpapers & Tactical Optics
releaseNotes:
• 01 Four New Khroma AI Themes: Neon Emerald, Arctic Cyan, Synthwave Violet, and Golden Obsidian with calibrated OLED black levels and WCAG AAA/AA contrast compliance.
• 02 Dynamic Theme Carousel: Studio sheet upgraded to an interactive horizontal carousel featuring all 10 selectable themes.
• 03 Six New Mathematical Procedural Wallpapers: Expanded to 10 total wallpapers, adding Aurora Caustic (gradient mesh), Quantum Waves (sinusoids), Tactical Hex Matrix (honeycomb), Bento Grid (architectural crosshairs), Delaunay Mesh (Haikei low-poly triangulation), and Isometric Cyber (Fffuel 3D matrix).
• 04 AGSL Optical Refraction & Tactical Scanlines: Hardware-accelerated Snell's law chromatic dispersion and night-vision phosphor scanlines on Android 13+.
• 05 Multi-Stage Tactile Overscroll Haptics: Progressive micro-tick resistance pulses during logarithmic rubber-band travel and rebound restitution thud.
